tests.steps: 1. Open 'Request leave' 2. Choose 10 March to 14 March 3. Submit
tests.expected: The request is saved and shown as 'Waiting for manager'

tests.steps: 1. Open 'Request leave' 2. Choose the same day as start and end 3. Submit
1. Open 'Request leave' 2. Choose 14 March as start and 10 March as end 3. Submit
tests.expected: The request is blocked with the message that the end date must be on or after the start date

tests.steps: 1. Open 'Request leave' 2. Leave the end date empty 3. Submit
tests.expected: The request is blocked and the end date field is highlighted

tests.steps: 1. Give a staff member 3 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member 7 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: 5 days are carried over and 2 days are shown as lost

tests.steps: 1. Test with 5 unused days 2. Test again with 6 unused days
tests.expected: 5 days: all 5 carried over (allowed). 6 days: only 5 carried over, 1 lost (blocked)

tests.steps: 1. Submit a leave request 2. Log in as the line manager and approve it
tests.expected: The staff member gets an 'Approved' email with the dates

tests.steps: 1. Submit a leave request 2. Leave it waiting
tests.expected: No email is sent until the manager decides

tests.steps: 1. Submit a leave request 2. Log in as the line manager and decline it
tests.expected: The staff member gets a 'Declined' email

tests.steps: 1. Approve a request 2. Then decline the same request
tests.expected: Exactly two emails are sent, one per decision, in the right order

tests.steps: 1. Give a staff member 6 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member exactly 10 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
1. Give a staff member 11 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: Only 10 days are carried over and 1 day is shown as lost (11 is blocked)

tests.steps: 1. Give a staff member 15 unused days on 31 December 2. Run the new-year process
tests.expected: Only 10 days are carried over and 5 days are shown as lost
